question: J week directive: 'if SPY breaks down Tuesday with VIX at 16, NO arm can short' -- quantify what the shut bear door (filter 8: VIX > 17.30 AND vix_rising) cost in the post-level-feed-fix era (2026-07-31 + 2026-08-03), prereg the A/B only if the number is real. Graveyard already holds 'filter-8 relax (both arms)' -- this is a post-fix-era re-quantification, not a retest.
method: backtest/tools/postfix_gate_costing.py (gate_expiry_check machinery: armed rows, 15-min clustering, real-OPRA ATM replay, premium_stop -8%, recency exit shape). Sole-blocker mining: a filter's true binding cohort = HOLD rows where it is the ONLY failed filter (C15: multi-blocker rows are cascade cohorts, no single filter may claim them).

findings.meaning: In the whole post-fix window there was not one tick where the VIX floor was the only thing between the engine and a bear entry. Lifting/lowering 17.3 alone would have admitted ZERO additional bear trades.
findings.cascade_membership: 8 appears only in multi-blocker combos, dominated by ribbon-BULL co-blocks: bear combos 5|8|9|10 x447 rows, 5|8 x221, 5|7|8|9|10 x190, 5|8|9 x157 (per-account HOLD rows, both cores). The bear door on these two sessions was shut by market STRUCTURE (ribbon/breakdown-bar/HTF), with VIX merely co-signing.

oracle_5_8_both_lifted.label: ORACLE (upper bound; requires ALSO deleting filter 5 ribbon-stack -- which is GRAVEYARDED, tested-dead)
oracle_5_8_both_lifted.note: The only bear money in the window lives behind the ribbon filter, not the VIX floor. Unreachable by any filter-8 change alone.

findings.floor_self_opening_evidence: Friday 2026-07-31's real morning breakdown (RTH low 737.68) RAISED VIX above the floor (17.35-17.68 readings in the refused-rows record) -- the floor OPENED exactly when the breakdown was real. Bear sole-blocker rows during that stretch were [5] (ribbon), n=2 events/account, priced +$83.52 safe / +$118.40 bold (n=2, NOISE-LEVEL, disclosed not headline). The feared scenario (breakdown with VIX pinned under 17.3) did not occur in the post-fix era.
findings.second_reason_not_to_widen: core_strategy_bear recency is RED on the standing instrument (real fills exp -$60.90/tr, n=10, window 2026-06-26..2026-07-31) -- the bear strategy is losing on the freshest window even when its door IS open. Widening the door has no evidentiary support tonight.

verdict: NO PREREG FILED -- the number is not real. Post-fix cost of the 17.3 floor alone = $0 (zero sole-blocked events). The graveyard verdict on filter-8 relax stands unchallenged by post-fix data.
standing_watch_condition: First session that produces bear sole-blocker [8] events (a breakdown day with VIX < 17.3) -> rerun backtest/tools/postfix_gate_costing.py --start <that-date> and revisit. Until that cohort exists there is nothing to A/B. Queue item filed to extend the nightly gate-expiry instrument with this sole-blocker miner so the watch is mechanical, not remembered.
n_small_disclosure: Two sessions, both with morning-selloff-then-bull-recovery character; every cell here is n-small and disclosed as such. This artifact quantifies a door's binding frequency, not an edge.
CORRECTED_2026_08_08_SAME_EVENING: See 'corrections' array below (POSTFIX-GATE-COSTING-UNSOUND-REPLAY fix, strategy/candidates/_lesson-inbox/2026-08-08-monitor-inherited-an-unsound-engine.md). This artifact's own 'method' line (backtest/tools/postfix_gate_costing.py) was, at generation time, forward-replaying via gate_expiry_check.simulate_event -> lib.simulator_real.simulate_trade_real -- the same unsound engine (exit-shape divergence, intrabar look-ahead) documented against gate-registry-status.json. The headline verdict (sole_blocker_8_bear_events=0, floor cost=$0) is a POPULATION-COUNT fact, unaffected by replay engine choice, and stands unchanged.
